content.short: CNFTSwap is a fully automated escrow service where you can safely trade ADA and CNFTs one to one.
content.description:
We are not a DEX, we are not a marketplace, what are we? To put it simple, CNFTSwap is a fully automated escrow service where you can trade ADA and CNFTs one to one, without human intervention. We realized that the Cardano community was lacking such a system which paved the way for scammers and manipulators. With CNFTSwap we try to achieve the following goals: Stop scammers Until this day, scamming is a big problem in the CNFT space. With CNFTSwap people will be able to trade safely and securely. Trading Trading is our key point of view. We try to offer the best trading experience there is. We also try to stimulate trading in general. Help newcomers We try to help new people in Cardano understand how trading works and offer help where needed.
